verdict.rationale: Firestore documents ACID transactions, atomic batch operations, and queries with chained filters and sorting. However, its model is document/collection-based, and nothing in the pack documents joins or relational constraints. Firebase SQL Connect appears only as a name in the MCP-server docs, with no description of its query capabilities. Community comments also note limited server-side query options and a desire for a deeper query language. missing for 10: documented relational joins, foreign-key or schema constraints, relational query language docs (e.g. for SQL Connect), independent hands-on corroboration.
